description: Start a paid job billed to the user's Desearch balance: collect public contact data for companies you already know, by domain. Send 1-200 domains or URLs; each is reduced to its host without www., lowercased, and deduplicated, and the task reads every one. Returns a task_id at once, with the task's status and reserved_cost_usd. You get one company per domain with the same fields as company-search but no fit score (score is null). The task's count is the number of domains left after deduplication. Cost: the call reserves one company per domain sent at the Company Enrich per-company price at the time of the call (reserved_cost_usd; prices at https://desearch.ai/pricing). When the task ends you pay only for the companies it delivered (final_cost_usd; a minimum of 1; a task that delivers none is free) and the rest of the reservation, including duplicate domains, is returned. Data: Desearch reads public data only: each company's own website (its homepage and its contact, about, team, and imprint pages), public web search results, and public LinkedIn profiles of its leaders. Each company comes back with its location, public emails, phones, and social profiles, and its leaders (roles) with their title, LinkedIn profile, and emails. Every contact keeps the page it came from (source_url). Leader emails can be inferred from the company's address pattern (source: inferred, with a confidence), and every email is checked (verification: valid, invalid, risky, or unknown). Companies stay readable for 30 days after the task ends. The task runs in the background: poll company-search-status with the task_id to read progress and the companies delivered so far. Each company is delivered first with enrichment status partial, and the later stages (contact pages, leaders, inferred emails, email checks) fill it in until it is complete. Use company-search-pause, company-search-resume, or company-search-cancel to pause, resume, or cancel it. Do not start the same task twice; send idempotency_key so a retry returns the first task instead of charging again. To find companies from a description, use company-search instead.

domains.description: 1-200 company domains or URLs, example: ['acme.com', 'https://www.beta.io/about']. Each is reduced to its host without www. and lowercased; duplicates are removed.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this task, for example a UUID. Sending the same key again returns the first task and is not charged again.

infer_emails.description: Guess leaders' emails from the company's address pattern (for example first.last), learned from the addresses found on its site (API default true). Inferred emails say source: inferred and carry a confidence: high when the pattern was learned from this company's own addresses, low for a common pattern.

metadata.description: Your own labels for this task, example: {"campaign": "q4-outbound"}. Up to 10 keys; keys are 1-40 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_', '.', '-'; values are strings of up to 200 characters. Returned on the task; filter company-search-tasks by it. The task does not use it.

roles.description: The leaders to look for: any of 'ceo', 'founder', 'cto', 'cfo', 'coo', 'cmo', 'president', 'owner', 'managing_director' (API default ['ceo', 'founder', 'cto', 'cfo']). A managing director (Geschäftsführer) counts as 'ceo' when 'ceo' is asked for.

verify_emails.description: Check every email: syntax, mail server (MX) and, for inferred ones, a web search (API default true). Each email then has a verification: valid, invalid, risky, or unknown. Set false to finish sooner without it.
